learning_outcomes.text: Extend theoretical and practical knowledge and acquire basic skills in the design of machine parts and mechanisms following up on Machine Elements and Mechanisms I and utilizing knowledge from Mechanics, Strength and Elasticity, and Engineering Design.
Clarify basic calculating theories and models, procedures of calculations, and design principles of machine elements and assembly units, primarily in the zone of mechanical drives.

Practical realization of knowledge at the solution of complex design tasks aimed at driving systems, including elaboration of preliminary design, looking for optimum variants of solution, check calculations and drawings. Comparison between design calculations elaborated with and without use of computer SW.

syllabus_topics: Preliminary design calculations, design arrangement, check calculations, drawings.
Single-stage gearbox provided with cylindrical helical gears and additional belt drive.
Single-stage gearbox provided with bevel mating gears and additional chain drive.
Inelastic or elastic shaft coupling added to the task 1 or 2.
Crank mechanism used for single-cylinder piston engine (working machine).

assessment_methods.method: elaboration and delivery of assigned design works according to operating plan of tutorials and given demands
